entry.name: jit.gl.gridshape
entry.digest: Generate simple geometric shapes as a grid
entry.description: Creates one of several simple shapes (sphere, torus, cylinder, opencyclinder, cube, opencube, plane, circle) laid out on a connected grid. These shapes may be either rendered directly, or sent out the leftmost outlet as a matrix of values.
